designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1991 with a donated 40-acre tract of salt marsh on Siletz Bay near Lincoln City, Oregon.

authority.citation: Land donation to the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Siletz Bay National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
Federal Register, Sept. 17, 2012 (2012-22960), Oregon coast refuges CCP: Siletz Bay NWR "was established in 1991 with a donation of 40 acres of tidally muted salt marsh"
